document.abstract: On Tuesday, 23 November, John Gallagher moderated a panel discussion about the making of the film Apollo 11, specifically the IMAX version. The panel consisted of the key production crew involved in the film, including director Todd Douglas Miller, Final Frame chief executive officer and colorist Will Cox, and sound mixer Eric Milano. The meeting was held virtually with 49 participants.
